correctness.rationale: The complete proof fixes all operator and heat-kernel normalizations. It derives the two asymptotic lower edges via the monomial gamma law, coherent Gaussian radial limit, and almost-periodic recurrence; proves the sharp L1 upper bound at the unique Gaussian crossing; obtains matching smooth periodic approximations with quantified tails and mollification error; and rules out attainment using compact Bohr translation hull plus the L1-Linfinity equality condition. An executed standalone checker provides finite, non-certifying diagnostics only.

value.rationale: The natural size of Berezin false positives for essential positivity has an exact uniform-normalized sharp bound, independent of the ambient complex dimension. Unlike merely reproducing one-frequency failure, this result resolves an all-profile variational invariant, gives the unique localized sharp transition length, proves unattained optimality and produces smooth periodic near-extremizers. Its precise quantity provides a reproducible quantitative benchmark for the recently disproved positivity criterion; no claims are made for unrestricted measurable profiles.
